meta.source: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education), via MoSPI eSankhyiki
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each survey year is a cross-section; the five years (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index.
meta.coverage: States/UTs and All India; estimated student enrolment by level (Ph.D. to certificate, and all levels) and by gender, five survey years.
meta.note: Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. In every state and year the eight levels sum to 'All levels', and women plus men to the total (asserted in scripts/validate.mjs).
